defensiveAbilities.name: Arm Cannon
defensiveAbilities.description: A daipex's powerful arms can be fused into one or more cannons. These arm cannons also can't be Disarmed or Released. The daipex takes a –4 circumstance penalty to any action that requires fine motor control.

defensiveAbilities.name: Char Miasma
defensiveAbilities.description: 5 feet. The heat from a daipex's arm cannons burns the intestines fed into the grafted weapons as ammunition. A creature that enters or begins its turn in the aura must succeed at a DC 23 Fortitude Saving Throw save or be Sickened 1.

defensiveAbilities.name: Misfire Vulnerability
defensiveAbilities.description: A daipex is full of unceasing rage and despises it when they can't deal damage. When a daipex critically fails a Strike or when a creature critically succeeds at its save against Hail of Bullets, the daipex takes 3d6 Mental Damage damage.

offensiveAbilities.name: Hail of Bullets
offensiveAbilities.description: The daipex fires a 30ft Type:cone of bullets, dealing 6d10 Piercing Damage damage (Basic DC 26 Reflex Saving Throw save) to creatures in the area. The daipex is pushed 10 feet in the opposite direction and can't use Hail of Bullets again for 1d4 rounds.

offensiveAbilities.name: Rain of Bullets
offensiveAbilities.description:
Frequency once per round

Effect The daipex makes two arm cannon Strikes against a single target. The daipex's multiple attack penalty is applied normally. If both Strikes hit, combine their damage for the purpose of resistances and weaknesses.

offensiveAbilities.name: Recoil
offensiveAbilities.description: A daipex's relatively small legs can't withstand their arm cannon's kickback. When a daipex makes an arm cannon Strike, they're pushed 5 feet in the opposite direction of the Strike's target. The daipex can take a –2 circumstance penalty to the Strike to avoid this forced movement.

rituals.name: Demonic Pact
rituals.description:
You call in a favor from one demon of level 2 or lower, two demons of level 0 or lower, or three demons of level –1 or lower.

Critical Success You conjure the demon or demons. They are eager to pursue the task, so they don't ask for a favor.

Success You conjure the demon or demons. They are not eager to pursue the task, so they require a favor in return.

Failure You don't conjure any demons.

Critical Failure The demon or demons are angry that you disturbed them. They appear before you, but they immediately attack you.

Heightened (+1) Increase the level of demon you call by 2 for each option.
rituals.primaryCheck: Religion (expert; you must be a demon)
